audience: website owners and marketers who track visitors with Pirsch Analytics

useCases.title: Check visitors and growth for a period
useCases.text: The AI reads totals (visitors, views, sessions, bounce rate), the daily trend, growth against the previous period and who is on the site now.

useCases.title: Find top pages and landing pages
useCases.text: The AI lists pages with visitors, views, bounce rate and time on page, or only landing or exit pages, narrowed by country or path.

useCases.title: See where visitors come from
useCases.text: The AI lists referrers and traffic channels such as Organic Search and Paid Search, and visitors per UTM source, medium or campaign.

useCases.title: Compare countries, browsers and devices
useCases.text: The AI lists visitors per country, region, city or language, per browser or operating system, and the split between desktop and mobile.

useCases.title: Check goals and funnel drop-off
useCases.text: The AI reads conversion goals with their conversion rate and the visitors per funnel step, with the drop-off between steps.

useCases.title: Review custom events and their values
useCases.text: The AI lists custom events with count and conversion rate, the values of one metadata key, and the pages where an event happened.
